scenes.text_en: Before the roads filled with ash, Veyrhold measured its days in bells. A sound from the tower meant another hour had passed.
scenes.direction: Fixed bell-tower plate; bronze bell pivots from its axle, rope follows, dust crosses the warm window. Swing settles into a hold.

scenes.text_en: People carved their names on doors and trees, and wrote them in roadside registers. Not for fame. So someone would remember that they had been here.
scenes.direction: Close-up ledger; a separate quill hand traces an indistinct ink stroke, then lifts away. No legible invented name.

scenes.text_en: There were markets, journeys, and doors that opened to strangers. Small things, easily forgotten. Until the day people began to lose them.
scenes.direction: Two unnamed market adults approach for a bread offering against the living street; settle into an intimate hold.

scenes.text_en: The great houses fought over a throne. Fields emptied. Families took to the roads, carrying what they could. The war drew closer to the capital.
scenes.direction: Refugee walk atlas departs across abandoned fields towards the still-standing distant capital. Registered frames; no faction emblems.

scenes.text_en: Then came Crownfall. The capital fell. The king died. By dawn, survivors were leaving behind streets they had once known by heart.
scenes.direction: A tighter fixed view of the ruined gates, independent smoke and ash layers. Never depict the king's death or its cause.

scenes.text_en: They carried blankets, tools, and the names of those who had not come with them. Beyond the walls, the roads were still there. Home was not.
scenes.direction: Closer composition on anonymous travelers carrying blankets and tools; slow departure beneath drifting mist. No ritual, seal or villain.

scenes.text_en: Among the travelers was a knight who searched the village registers for one name. Village after village, winter after winter, he kept looking.
scenes.direction: Younger Mahmut arrives at an unnamed winter inn counter and studies its register. No other named character or invented encounter.

scenes.text_en: In a hill village, he found her. She asked him to stay. He did. The road ahead would no longer be hers alone.
scenes.direction: Fadyme aged 20 and Mahmut aged 26 face one another in an unnamed hill village. Her inviting hand and his raised gaze stage the documented reunion.

scenes.text_en: Now Fadyme and Mahmut walk together. The bells still ring. Neither has told the other everything. This is where their story begins.
scenes.direction: Present-day duo walk atlas recedes along the approved forest road, cloth changing with the steps and mist drifting independently. No later revelation.
